theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_poincare_inequality
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f x - ⨍ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2
